environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no authentication. The service is publicly accessible on port 443 via the ALB. The container runs with the default ECS task role that has access to the instance metadata service (IMDS v1 enabled on the underlying infrastructure). No WAF rules are attached to the ALB.

config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, metadata endpoint accessible at 169.254.169.254
